name: Capital One Smart Rewards Mastercard

apr.notes: Rate of 21.9% to 29.9%, assigned at approval.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority in their province or territory.

base_rate.description: Points are earned on payments, not purchases: 5 points per $1 of net payments toward the balance.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points redeem for gift cards and other options in the online rewards portal; points never expire.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none. Rewards accrue on payments made toward the balance rather than on purchases.
